Test_Description: Verify reset value of register gp0_gpio_8 at offset 0x0 after hreset_n assertion.
Test_Procedure: 1. Assert hreset_n (active low async reset). 2. Release reset. 3. Read register gp0_gpio_8 at offset 0x0. 4. Compare read value with expected reset value 0x00100000 (io_ctrl=1 at bit20).
Expected_Result: Read value from gp0_gpio_8 must match expected reset value 0x00100000.
Register_Description: Determines the level gpio pin; RAWST bit interrupt raw status; Writing 1 clears interrupt raw status; Pos-edge interrupt enable; Neg-edge interrupt enable; GPIO Pin signal level select; GPIO mode select input/output; dout value to gpio pin
Remarks: Covers gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30 per-pin registers. Each has identical field layout.

Test_Description: Write pattern 0x00000000 to all writable fields of gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30 and read back.
Test_Procedure: 1. For each register gp0_gpio_8 to gp0_gpio_30: write 0x00000000. 2. Read back each register. 3. Compare read value with expected value masked by READ_MASK.
Expected_Result: Read-back value must match 0x00000000 AND READ_MASK for each register.
Remarks: Pattern 0x00000000 tests all-zeros write to writable fields.

Test_Description: Write pattern 0xFFFFFFFF to all writable fields of gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30 and read back.
Test_Procedure: 1. For each register gp0_gpio_8 to gp0_gpio_30: write 0xFFFFFFFF. 2. Read back each register. 3. Compare read value with expected value masked by WRITE_MASK and READ_MASK.
Expected_Result: Read-back value must match 0xFFFFFFFF AND WRITE_MASK AND READ_MASK for each register.
Remarks: Pattern 0xFFFFFFFF tests all-ones write to writable fields.

Test_Description: Verify that RO field data_in (bit 0) in gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30 is not writable.
Test_Procedure: 1. Read current value of data_in field. 2. Attempt to write inverted value. 3. Read back and verify data_in field is unchanged.
Expected_Result: data_in field (bit 0) must remain unchanged after write attempt.
Register_Description: Determines the level gpio pin. Read returns the current value of the corresponding pin regardless of whether the pin is an input or an output.
Remarks: RO field verification for data_in across all per-pin registers.

Test_Description: Verify that RO field intr_raw_sts (bit 1) in gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30 is not writable.
Test_Procedure: 1. Read current value of intr_raw_sts field. 2. Attempt to write inverted value. 3. Read back and verify intr_raw_sts field is unchanged.
Expected_Result: intr_raw_sts field (bit 1) must remain unchanged after write attempt.
Register_Description: RAWST bit: Interrupt raw status. On Read returns latched raw interrupt status based on interrupt settings.
Remarks: RO field verification for intr_raw_sts across all per-pin registers.

Test_Description: Verify that WO field intr_clr (bit 16) in gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30 reads as 0.
Test_Procedure: 1. Read register gp0_gpio_8. 2. Check that bit 16 (intr_clr) reads as 0. 3. Repeat for all per-pin registers.
Expected_Result: intr_clr field (bit 16) must always read as 0 (write-only field).
Register_Description: Writing 1 clears the interrupt raw status. Writing 0 No change.
Remarks: WO field verification for intr_clr across all per-pin registers.

Test_Description: Verify GPIO registers return to reset values after soft reset via SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS.
Test_Procedure: 1. Write test patterns to gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30. 2. Trigger soft reset via SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS. 3. Read all registers and verify reset values.
Expected_Result: All registers must return to their default reset values after soft reset.
Remarks: SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS macro unresolved from header file RAG.

Test_Description: Verify RW2 type fields io_ctrl (bit 20) and dout (bit 21) in gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30 support read-write with hardware feedback.
Test_Procedure: 1. Write 0 to io_ctrl (set output mode). 2. Read back and verify io_ctrl reflects written value or hardware override. 3. Write 1 to dout. 4. Read back and verify dout reflects written value or hardware override.
Expected_Result: RW2 fields io_ctrl and dout must reflect written values subject to hardware feedback (2xin signals).
Register_Description: GPIO mode select: 0-output mode 1-input mode; dout: Value to be written to gpio pin in output mode
Remarks: RW2 field type has hardware feedback path (2xin signals).

Test_Description: Verify level-select HIGH interrupt generation for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39). Configure each pin for level-1 interrupt and verify interrupt assertion.
Test_Procedure: 1. Enable GPIO0 interrupt in LSS sysreg via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 (offset 0x28). 2. For each GPIO pin i (8-39): a. Configure gp0_gpio_i: set level_sel=1 (bit19) for HIGH level interrupt. b. Set io_ctrl=0 (bit20) for output mode. c. Set dout=1 (bit21) to drive HIGH. 3. Enable interrupt in gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (offset 0x84) for pin i. 4. Drive external stimulus via 0xA0243ffc. 5. Read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 (offset 0x88) and verify interrupt bit is set. 6. Read MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 (offset 0x24) and verify gpio0_intr bit (bit 1) is set.
Expected_Result: Interrupt status bit for the corresponding GPIO pin must be set in gp0_intr1_intr_sts1. gpio0_intr bit must be set in LSS sysreg raw_stcr1.
Register_Description: GPIO Pin signal level select; GPIO mode select; dout value; Interrupt enable per pin; Interrupt masked status per pin
Remarks: Tests active HIGH level interrupt for all 32 GPIO pins.

Test_Description: Verify level-select LOW interrupt generation for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39). Configure each pin for level-0 interrupt and verify interrupt assertion.
Test_Procedure: 1. Enable GPIO0 interrupt in LSS sysreg via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 (offset 0x28). 2. For each GPIO pin i (8-39): a. Configure gp0_gpio_i: set level_sel=0 (bit19) for LOW level interrupt. b. Set io_ctrl=0 (bit20) for output mode. c. Set dout=0 (bit21) to drive LOW. 3. Enable interrupt in gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (offset 0x84) for pin i. 4. Drive external stimulus via 0xA0243ffc. 5. Read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 (offset 0x88) and verify interrupt bit is set. 6. Read MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 (offset 0x24) and verify gpio0_intr bit (bit 1) is set.
Expected_Result: Interrupt status bit for the corresponding GPIO pin must be set in gp0_intr1_intr_sts1. gpio0_intr bit must be set in LSS sysreg raw_stcr1.
Register_Description: GPIO Pin signal level select; GPIO mode select; dout value; Interrupt enable per pin; Interrupt masked status per pin
Remarks: Tests active LOW level interrupt for all 32 GPIO pins.

Test_Description: Verify group interrupt raw status register gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 (offset 0x80) reflects individual pin interrupt status and supports clear-on-write-1.
Test_Procedure: 1. Configure GPIO pin for level interrupt and trigger interrupt. 2. Read gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 (offset 0x80) and verify corresponding bit is set. 3. Write 1 to the corresponding bit to clear. 4. Read back and verify bit is cleared.
Expected_Result: Corresponding bit in gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 must be set when interrupt is active and cleared after write-1.
Register_Description: RAWST bit: Interrupt raw status and clear for each GPIO pin. On Read returns latched raw interrupt status. Writing 1 clears the interrupt.
Remarks: VRRW type register - variable read/write with clear-on-write-1 behavior.

Test_Description: Verify that disabling interrupt via gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (offset 0x84) prevents interrupt status assertion in gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 (offset 0x88).
Test_Procedure: 1. Configure GPIO pin for level interrupt. 2. Write 0x00000000 to gp0_intr1_intr_en1 to disable all interrupts. 3. Trigger interrupt condition. 4. Read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 and verify no interrupt status bits are set. 5. Re-enable interrupt and verify status is now asserted.
Expected_Result: gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 must read 0x00000000 when interrupts are disabled. After re-enabling the corresponding bit must be set.
Register_Description: Interrupt enable per pin; Interrupt masked status per pin
Remarks: Verifies interrupt masking behavior through enable register.

Test_Description: Verify GPIO0 interrupt propagation to LSS sysreg level. Verify raw_stcr1 (offset 0x24) gpio0_intr bit and intr_en1 (offset 0x28) gpio0_intr enable bit.
Test_Procedure: 1. Enable gpio0_intr (bit 1) in MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 (offset 0x28). 2. Trigger GPIO interrupt. 3. Read MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 (offset 0x24) and verify gpio0_intr (bit 1) is set. 4. Write 1 to gpio0_intr bit in raw_stcr1 to clear. 5. Read back and verify cleared.
Expected_Result: gpio0_intr bit (bit 1) in raw_stcr1 must be set when GPIO interrupt is active. Must clear after write-1.
Register_Description: Interrupt raw status/clear for GPIO0; Interrupt enable for GPIO0
Remarks: LSS sysreg integration test for GPIO0 interrupt routing.

Test_Description: Verify external stimulus register at hardcoded address 0xA0243ffc correctly drives GPIO pin levels for interrupt testing.
Test_Procedure: 1. Write value to 0xA0243ffc to set GPIO pin levels. 2. Verify GPIO data_in (bit 0) in corresponding gp0_gpio_x register reflects the driven level. 3. Verify interrupt is triggered based on level_sel configuration.
Expected_Result: GPIO data_in must reflect the level driven by 0xA0243ffc. Interrupt must trigger according to level_sel setting.
Register_Description: External stimulus register for driving GPIO pin levels during interrupt testing.
Remarks: Hardcoded hex address 0xA0243ffc - not mapped in GPIO register spec. Used as external stimulus.
